projects.title: Apps
projects.intro: Apps made at talfahrt, live now. Try them, play them, pass them on.

gruppetto.tagline: The app for Grand Tour fans
gruppetto.description: The key news, every stage with profile and classifications, a prediction league with friends and mini games in between – all in one app.

fitcheck.tagline: Your wardrobe as a sticker album
fitcheck.description: Snap your clothes – Fitcheck cuts them out and sorts them by type, colour and style. See a look you like in a screenshot or on Pinterest, and the app rebuilds it from your own wardrobe.

neontd.description: Eight worlds, 48 tracks and a new arena every week where everyone plays by the same rules. If you want the top spot, every tower has to count.

sattelfest.description: One articulated lorry, one tight loading bay, and every centimetre counts. Sattelfest is a truck parking simulator seen from above: reverse up to the dock, line it up cleanly, no scratches, against the clock.

architectures.title: Architectures
architectures.intro: Patterns that have proven themselves in production.

items.title: A cluster that breathes with the load
items.text: More requests, more instances. When it calms down, the system scales back – no panic, no idle servers.

items.title: A cache between database and frontend
items.text: Either load everything up front and keep it fresh in the background – or fetch on demand when an entry is first needed. When a record changes, exactly that entry is dropped.

items.title: Deployment without downtime
items.text: The new version starts next to the old one, passes its checks and only then takes over. Instance by instance – nobody notices a thing.

items.title: Events instead of file exchange
items.text: Every system writes into a shared stream and reads at its own pace. If one drops out, the messages wait – nothing gets lost.

items.title: One photo, and the app knows
items.text: A vision model reads receipts, clothes or meter readings and returns clean data. The backend checks every answer – anything uncertain goes to a person.

items.title: Monitoring that speaks up first
items.text: Metrics, logs and alerts in one place. When things slow down, the system speaks up – before anyone notices.
